lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My internet has been down since this morning. I'm in Baneshwor.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. There's a fibre cut affecting part of Baneshwor. Our team is on site, and we expect service back by four this afternoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Can someone call me when it's fixed?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yes. I've opened a ticket on your account and added a callback. You'll get a call and an SMS as soon as your line is back.
